description: Which charts of a coin, or of every coin, stand furthest from normal right now: each chart's latest reading against its own last four years (z-score and percentile), high or low, with the days since it was last this far out. The quickest way to see what is unusual on chain, in derivatives or in flows today. Without an API key it shows the top rows of the free charts and counts the rest by the plan that shows them.

asset.description: Coin code, for example BTC or ETH, or ALL for every coin.

direction.description: Charts unusually high, unusually low, or both.

interval.description: Resolution: 24h daily. get_metric_metadata gives the intervals a metric offers.

query.description: Optional words a chart's name, id or folder must hold, for example "exchange", "funding" or "miners".

name: find_extremes
title: Metrics at extremes
